description: Returns every parameter one tracking hit's request carried (client and session ids, gcs and gcd with gcd decoded per consent signal, page, device and event parameters), where it was sent, and its consent. Step results list each hit with an [h] number; pass that and the step number.

hit.description: The hit's [h] number in that step.

step.description: The step number from the step result's first line.

name: get_hit
title: Show one tracking hit in full
